log: Act VI, R6: from the frozen end of Act V back into Elysia (R1, R2), then the inn (R5): the table, the three offers; then she stands up, the host lets her go with the soup, and he is the same host afterwards
the end of Act V: the house
Weiter begins the day after
the walk to the gap is R1 and R2 (akt6_leere, akt6_spalt): here the light is simply there
out into the valley, to the place where she arrived in the rain
the gap of light: she stands in it
she touches it: the look, five lines, and then the question
the five lines of the look, one click each (a wait would click through the question too)
the question stands on Stay: she moves to Going through
a step, the light, the black, and Elysia
the corner builds itself up, the garden as she left it
into the inn: the host waits, the table in the middle is laid
the walk moves on from the garden to the inn
he waves with his whole arm as she steps up to the bar
the hearth: the dip in the carpet, the folded blanket, the bowl, the note (the why of his strategy, as a thing)
she sits down at the table in the middle: the first offer (soup), the second (music), the third (the quiet); every first answer is staying
after the third the game saves once; nothing was given, nothing taken
all three offers are behind her; she sits, and nobody holds her
she stands up by her own step: a key, never an answer in a menu
the host asks once, lightly, and lets go: the soup is on the table, and she takes it
the walk moves on from the inn to the standing
afterwards he is the same host, without an offer: the other half of a host's work, a thanks for the soup
segment finished
